title: 第4章 遇故人第5章 达成共识
content_zh:
第一卷 重生归来 第四章 遇故人
苏芮不着痕迹的打量了陶泽西，这个人一点也不像青木这个小县城能养出来的。
他站在那里让人难以忽略，光洁的脸庞，透着棱角分明的冷峻，乌黑深邃的眼眸，浓密的剑眉，高高的鼻梁，再加上那好像什么都无所谓的坏笑。
苏芮觉得这个人似曾相识，前世他肯定见过他！就是不知道是爷爷外公那边的还是吴家那边的。
想到吴家，苏芮眼里透出毁灭的仇恨，不过很快就被她掩盖。瞬间她又变成那个刚刚失去父母，彷徨的孤女。
有意思，实在是太有意思了，其实苏芮打量陶泽西的时候，陶泽西就已经发现了，只不过没有拆穿而已，他现在对苏芮越来越好奇了。
“你好，我是青木派出所的陶泽西，需要找你了解下情况，你跟我来一下。”他对着苏芮说。
苏芮听到他自我介绍叫陶泽西，愣了一下，陶泽西，她终于知道他是谁了，前世陶泽西的父亲是陶靖民，而陶靖民还是舅舅的大学同窗。所以陶靖民理所当然的成为叶派的一员。每年都会去外公家里拜年。只是苏家和叶家被吴家设计，陶靖民不接受吴家的招揽，也从封疆大元贬到一个闲职混日子，一直意气风发的陶靖民如何能接受在一个闲职混日子，失意的陶靖民选择了远离官场回乡养老。现在的陶靖民在什么职位呢？看着陶泽西，也许可以找他帮忙。
目前先要拜托这对伯父伯母，而且她想要一个人生活还需要他帮忙。这一世她一定不会在那对极品抚养她。
跟着陶泽西和另一个中年警察来到一间空病房。中年警察先开口“你叫苏芮？说一下年龄，和跟死者的关系。青木中学的？今天你们学校应该开学吧，你为什么会出现在那里？”
“我…我是苏芮，苏璞是我父亲，叶蓉蓉是我母亲。今年14岁了，在青木中学上初二，今天…我上课睡着了。”她抿了抿嘴继续说道“梦到我爸爸妈妈去世，所以我就跑出去，结果…结果我父母就真的去世了…我不是故意梦到父母去世的…哇…爸爸妈妈，你们回来啊！别不要芮芮。呜…爸爸妈妈…”苏芮成功的伪装成了一个刚失去父母，孤苦无依，内心无措的孤女，至少那个中年警察就被骗过去了，而陶泽西要不是刚刚看到了苏芮的另一面，估计他也会认为她只是一个弱小可怜的小孤女。不过看到苏芮刚刚看李福那冷酷的眼神，陶泽西知道，她是一个懂得伪装的孤狼，就像当年野外训练遇到的那只受伤的孤狼，就算受伤，也能轻易杀死成年野猪。
陶泽西出去给她倒了一杯水，让她平静下来，待她平静后，中年警察继续开口“你现在未成年，父母还去世了，李福是你大伯？看来只能让他当你监护人，抚养你了，否则你只能去孤儿院。”
苏芮面露惊恐“不要！他们不是我亲人，我姓苏而他们一个姓李一个姓王，怎么会是亲戚！我不要让他抚养我！我不要！我要一个人过！”
“为什么？”陶泽西终于开口了。
“大…王春花要抢我家房子，她说他儿子要娶媳妇，要用我家房子当新房，那明明是我家盖的！而且他儿子跟我一样大，怎么可能结婚！李福经常上我家偷东西，每次我爸爸都说就当还李爷爷人情了，可是他还对我爸爸说把我卖掉，再生一个儿子！我不要去她家，我会被欺负的，我不要被卖掉！我宁愿一个人过！”说完低下头又呜呜的哭起来。
苏芮在心中冷笑，她可没冤枉他们，李福在村子中整天无所事事，而王春花的确说过把她家的房子给她儿子李狗蛋结婚用，不过是上辈子而已。上辈子李福还背着自己收王家村村长五百块钱礼金，让她嫁给村长的傻儿子王大树，只不过被她逃了。
“这…如果他们不是你的亲人的话你只能去孤儿院了。”中年武警无奈的摇摇头，“你才14岁，没有亲人在怎么可以一个人生活。”
“谁说我没有亲人，老树村后山脚那个老头就是我的亲人，他是我师傅，一日为师终身为父，如果要让人抚养我，我只要他抚养我！不信你可以去问他！”说完苏芮很忐忑，她只知道她们村后山脚下住着一个怪老头，很少和村子里的人打交道，苏芮也只见过他两次，鹤发童颜，精神矍铄，一身的气度，怎么看也不像是平常人。
老头住在一个四合院里，如果忽略周围的环境，一定以为身在京城脚下的四合院中。

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 4: Meeting an Old Friend
Su Rui looked at Tao Zexi without any trace. This man was nothing like what a small county like Qingmu could raise.
He stood there and was hard to ignore, with a smooth face showing sharp edges and coldness, deep black eyes, thick sword-shaped eyebrows, a high bridge of nose, plus that evil smile that seemed to mean nothing.
Su Rui felt that this person seemed familiar. He must have seen him in his previous life! I just don’t know if it’s from my grandparents’ side or the Wu family’s side.
Thinking of the Wu family, Su Rui's eyes showed destructive hatred, but it was quickly covered up by her. In an instant, she became the wandering orphan girl who had just lost her parents.
It's interesting, it's so interesting. In fact, when Su Rui looked at Tao Zexi, Tao Zexi had already noticed it, but he didn't expose it. Now he is becoming more and more curious about Su Rui.
"Hello, I'm Tao Zexi from Qingmu Police Station. I need to find out about the situation from you. Come with me." He said to Su Rui.
Su Rui was stunned for a moment when she heard him introduce himself as Tao Zexi. Tao Zexi, she finally knew who he was. In his previous life, Tao Zexi's father was Tao Jingmin, and Tao Jingmin was his uncle's college classmate. Therefore, Tao Jingmin naturally became a member of the Ye faction. Every year I go to my grandpa’s house to pay New Year greetings. It’s just that the Su family and the Ye family were set up by the Wu family. Tao Jingmin refused to accept the recruitment of the Wu family, and was demoted from the feudal era to living in a sinecure. How could Tao Jingmin, who had always been high-spirited, accept living in a sinecure? The frustrated Tao Jingmin chose to stay away from officialdom and return to his hometown to retire. What position does Tao Jingmin hold now? Looking at Tao Zexi, maybe we can ask him for help.
For now, she has to look after her uncle and aunt, and she needs his help if she wants to live alone. In this life, she will definitely not be raised by the best pair.
Follow Tao Zexi and another middle-aged policeman to an empty ward. The middle-aged policeman spoke first, "Your name is Su Rui? Tell me your age and your relationship with the deceased. Are you from Aoki Middle School? Your school should be starting today. Why are you there?"
"I... I am Su Rui, Su Pu is my father, and Ye Rongrong is my mother. I am 14 years old this year, and I am in the second grade of junior high school at Qingmu Middle School. Today... I fell asleep in class." She pursed her lips and continued, "I dreamed that my parents died, so I ran out, and... it turned out that my parents really died... I didn't mean to dream about my parents' death... Wow... Dad Mom and Dad, come back! Don't miss Rui Rui. Ugh... Mom and Dad..." Su Rui successfully pretended to be an orphan who had just lost her parents and was helpless. At least the middle-aged policeman was deceived. If Tao Zexi hadn't just seen another side of Su Rui, he would probably think that she was just a weak and pitiful little orphan. But seeing the cold look Su Rui gave Li Fu just now, Tao Zexi knew that she was a lone wolf who knew how to disguise, just like the injured lone wolf he encountered during the field training. Even if he was injured, he could easily kill an adult wild boar.
Tao Zexi went out and poured her a glass of water to calm her down. After she calmed down, the middle-aged policeman continued, "You are now a minor and your parents have passed away. Li Fu is your uncle? It seems that he can only be your guardian and raise you. Otherwise, you can only go to an orphanage."
Su Rui looked horrified, "No! They are not my relatives. My surname is Su and their surname is Li and Wang. How can they be relatives! I don't want him to raise me! I don't want it! I want to live alone!"
"Why?" Tao Zexi finally spoke.
"Big...Wang Chunhua wants to rob my house. She said that his son wants to get a wife and use my house as a new house. It was obviously built by my family! And his son is the same age as me, how can he get married! Li Fu often comes to my house to steal things. Every time, my father says that it is just a favor to Grandpa Li, but he also tells my father to sell me and have another child.son! I don’t want to go to her house, I will be bullied, I don’t want to be sold! I'd rather live alone! "After saying that, he lowered his head and started crying again.
Su Rui sneered in her heart. She had not wronged them. Li Fu had nothing to do in the village all day long, and Wang Chunhua did say that her house would be used for her son Li Goudan's wedding, but it was only in a previous life. In his previous life, Li Fu even accepted a gift of 500 yuan from the village chief of Wangjia Village behind his back to marry her to the village chief's stupid son Wang Dashu, but she escaped.
"This...if they are not your relatives, you can only go to the orphanage. The middle-aged armed policeman shook his head helplessly, "You are only 14 years old. How can you live alone without your relatives." "
"Who said I have no relatives? The old man at the foot of the mountain behind Laoshu Village is my relative. He is my master. Once a master, he will always be a father. If I want someone to raise me, I only need him to raise me! If you don’t believe it, you can ask him! "After saying that, Su Rui was very worried. She only knew that there was a strange old man living at the foot of the mountain behind their village. He rarely interacted with people in the village. Su Rui had only seen him twice. He had a childish face and long hair. He was energetic and had a demeanor that did not look like an ordinary person.
The old man lives in a courtyard. If you ignore the surrounding environment, you will definitely think that you are in a courtyard at the foot of the capital.
